name: Antigua Naval Dockyard and Related Archaeological Sites
description: On the sheltered southern coast of Antigua, this former British naval base fills a walled enclosure of Georgian-style buildings around a deep, narrow harbour. The surrounding hills sheltered ships from hurricanes, making it ideal for repairs. Built from the late 18th century to guard sugar planters' interests, it relied on generations of enslaved Africans' labour. Its restored buildings still line the waterfront today.
